00090A.d: A massive cannon tailored for mass destruction. It can pierce targets with its concentrated lasers.

t: Normal and heavy attacks fire a pink beam up to 130 units that pierces every enemy and box on its line, hitting each 3 times about 0.33 seconds apart for one-third of the attack's damage.
Special: leaps forward and plants the cannon. Three circles of laser pillars expand around you, and each circle hits up to 5 enemies or boxes inside it once for half of normal-attack damage.

With Altera Kanon and Murderer's Gleam also equipped: beams reach Rifle range, the circles double (36, 68 and 100 units), each special hit deals one-third of normal-attack damage, and each special hit that wounds has a 50% chance to also trigger Demon's.

It follows you and fights the nearest enemy in the room until it is defeated or you change area. After a defeat you can summon again in 3 seconds. An HP bar shows over every summon, and a summon that blocks your view of your character turns half transparent.

00040A.d: A memory of a lost daughter. Now turned into a weapon.

The special cannot be used inside a combo, and your techniques deal 10% more damage while it is equipped.
